svg.title: 1. Multi-account MLOps architecture
svg.text: Fraud scoring MLOps on AWS: one account per stage, models promoted through a shared registry
Gates before prod: integration tests on replayed traffic,
load test to 2x peak TPS, p99 model latency under 25 ms,
scores match the offline evaluation to 1e-6.
read-only share of the offline store (Lake Formation grant + KMS key policy)
KMS on all ML storage, training and
inference in VPC with network isolation.
